extDescription.message: Audio equalizer and volume booster for any tab: boost bass, tune sound, save presets, mute tabs, use shortcuts and auto-start.

points_reset_message.message: Changing the number of points will reset the current EQ settings.

capture_error_prefix.message: Failed to capture the audio stream. Try using "Tab capture".

add_to_autostart_tooltip.message: Add current site to autostart whitelist

autostart_validation_error.message: Enter a valid domain or URL and select a preset.

preset_delete_error.message: This preset is used in auto start rules. Remove the related rules first.

shortcut_validation_error.message: Use at least one modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Meta) and one letter or number.

shortcut_duplicate_error.message: This shortcut is already used by another command.

point_double_click_hint.message: Double-click a point to reset it.

q_factor_shift_hint.message: Hold Shift and drag points on the canvas to adjust the Q factor.

preset_name_reserved_error.message: This name is reserved for a built-in preset.

preset_name_duplicate_error.message: A preset with this name already exists.

guide_shortcuts_hint.message: You can change these shortcuts in Settings.

guide_canvas_hint.message: Drag points to shape the equalizer. Change the number of points in Settings.

guide_volume_hint.message: Use this slider to adjust the overall volume.

guide_presets_hint.message: Save the current setup or apply a preset here.

donation_reminder_message.message: If this extension is useful to you, you can support its development.

guide_spectrum_visualization_hint.message: You can also enable spectrum visualization in Settings.

equalizer_keyboard_help.message: Select a band with Home, End, Page Up or Page Down. Use arrows for frequency and gain, Shift+Up/Down for Q, and Enter to reset.

tab_capture_start_error.message: Could not start tab audio capture.

tab_capture_help.message: Use this mode if the equalizer does not work on a site. Audio processing continues when the popup is closed.

tab_capture_stop_error.message: Could not stop tab audio capture.

settings_transfer_missing_preset.message: Rule skipped: preset is missing or empty

settings_transfer_dependency.message: A retained rule requires this preset; choose another version

settings_transfer_ambiguous_rule.message: Current rules have conflicting preset assignments

settings_transfer_resolve_conflicts.message: Choose a version for each conflict

settings_transfer_privacy.message: Files can contain site addresses and personal preset names. Share them carefully. Current curves and tab state are not transferred.

settings_transfer_reset_warning.message: The current curve on this tab will be reset

settings_transfer_reset_acknowledgement.message: I understand that the current curve will be reset

settings_transfer_fallback_only.message: No tab selected: only the point count changes; curves stay unchanged

settings_transfer_fallback_reset.message: The shared fallback curve will also be reset

settings_transfer_enable_eq.message: The equalizer will be enabled on this tab

settings_transfer_stale.message: Settings or the selected tab changed. Review the updated import and choose again.

settings_transfer_blocked.message: Resolve all conflicts and acknowledge the reset before applying.

settings_transfer_read_error.message: Could not read settings. Select the file again to retry.

settings_transfer_version_error.message: This settings file version is not supported.

settings_transfer_file_error.message: This is not a valid settings or legacy presets file.

settings_transfer_write_error.message: Could not save settings. Your choices are preserved; try again.

settings_transfer_refresh_error.message: Settings were saved, but the popup could not refresh. Reopen it to see the changes.

settings_transfer_export_error.message: Could not export settings. Try again.

precise_frequency_ctrl_hint.message: Hold Ctrl and drag points horizontally for precise 1 Hz adjustments.
